svg.title: Arithmetic with recursion
svg.desc: Railroad diagram of a grammar with 5 rules and 19 terms. References are not expanded. It shows structure; it does not parse input. Supplied trace from provider gallery-stub for input "bad input": 1 attempts, 0 matched and 1 not matched. The library shows this external evidence and does not compute it.
